headline: The Hub is finished and says less. Week now places your late items and to-dos into free time, in your priority order, and every meeting has Prep and Jump in. Every tab uses fewer words, with each summary one press away behind a small icon, and titles read clean. You can change a commitment's date or take back a note you added, Slack direct and group messages list on the Inbox, and a refresh runs in one call. After updating, say "update my hub" and allow anything new it asks for once.
